analysis.summaryJa: このページはwithを「同じ場面に人・物・道具・原因・付帯状況をつなぐ」前置詞として整理する。単なる「〜と一緒に」だけでなく、所持、手段、材料、原因、with＋名詞＋説明語句、調和・同意・関係・容易さまでを一つの接続イメージで理解する。
grammarPoints: withは同行者や同席者を主となる出来事につなぐ
with＋名詞で人や物が備えている特徴・所持を後ろから説明できる
道具・手段・材料を示すwithは行為と使用物をつなぐ
感情や状態が原因となるときwith surpriseやwith coldのように表せる
with＋名詞＋形容詞・前置詞句・現在分詞・過去分詞で付帯状況を作る
agree with 人、go with、have to do with、with easeなどの定着表現がある
agree withは人・意見との一致、agree toは提案・条件の受諾を表す
visualEvidence: 中央のWITHハブから同行者、道具、表情、色、関係を示すカードへケーブルが伸びている
人・所持、道具・材料、原因・結果、同時状況の四方向へ接続が分岐している
with＋名詞＋説明語句のレールに形容詞・前置詞句・-ing・過去分詞の選択肢が示されている
agree with、go with、have to do with、with easeの表現が接続イメージの周囲に配置されている
commonTraps: 道具を表すwithと行為者を表すbyを混同する
with＋名詞＋分詞で名詞と分詞の能動・受動関係を見落とす
人への同意にagree toを使い、提案の受諾との違いを失う
withを常に「一緒に」とだけ訳し、原因・所持・付帯状況を読み取れない
have to do withを義務のhave toと誤って分解する

questions.prompt: The regional manager traveled to the new branch ------- two safety engineers.

choices.A: with
choices.B: by
choices.C: from
choices.D: during

questions.translationJa: 地域マネージャーは2人の安全技術者とともに新支店へ出張しました。
questions.explanationJa: 同行者を主語の移動に結び付けるためwithを使います。byは行為者や手段、fromは起点を表します。

questions.prompt: Please submit the warranty claim ------- all supporting receipts attached.

choices.A: for
choices.B: with
choices.C: by
choices.D: during

questions.translationJa: すべての証明用レシートを添付して保証請求を提出してください。
questions.explanationJa: with＋名詞＋過去分詞attachedで「レシートが添付された状態」という付帯状況を表します。

questions.prompt: The technician measured the gap ------- a digital gauge.

choices.A: by
choices.B: at
choices.C: with
choices.D: of

questions.translationJa: 技術者はデジタルゲージを使って隙間を測定しました。
questions.explanationJa: 行為に使用する具体的な道具はwithで示します。byは方法全体や行為者を示す場合に使われます。

questions.prompt: The conference snacks are prepared ------- locally grown herbs and vegetables.

choices.A: from among
choices.B: toward
choices.C: beside
choices.D: with

questions.translationJa: 会議用の軽食は地元産のハーブと野菜を使って調理されています。
questions.explanationJa: 料理に用いる材料・食材を行為につなぐ前置詞はwithです。

questions.prompt: Several passengers were shaking ------- cold when the replacement bus arrived.

choices.A: with
choices.B: by
choices.C: to
choices.D: for

questions.translationJa: 代替バスが到着したとき、数人の乗客は寒さで震えていました。
questions.explanationJa: shaking with coldは、寒さという原因が震えという状態を生じさせていることを表します。

questions.prompt: The receptionist greeted every visitor ------- a warm smile.

choices.A: at
choices.B: with
choices.C: from
choices.D: through

questions.translationJa: 受付担当者は温かい笑顔で来訪者一人ひとりを迎えました。
questions.explanationJa: 笑顔を伴う状況をgreetedという動作に結び付けるためwithを使います。

questions.prompt: The backup generator kept running, ------- its warning light flashing.

choices.A: by
choices.B: for
choices.C: with
choices.D: unless

questions.translationJa: 予備発電機は警告灯を点滅させたまま稼働し続けました。
questions.explanationJa: warning lightが能動的にflashingしているため、with＋名詞＋現在分詞で同時状況を表します。

questions.prompt: ------- the loading doors locked, the warehouse remained secure overnight.

choices.A: By
choices.B: For
choices.C: During
choices.D: With

questions.translationJa: 搬入口の扉が施錠された状態だったので、倉庫は一晩中安全に保たれました。
questions.explanationJa: doorsとlockedには受動関係があるため、With＋名詞＋過去分詞で背景状況を示します。

questions.prompt: I agree ------- Ms. Patel about the revised delivery schedule.

choices.A: with
choices.B: to
choices.C: for
choices.D: on to

questions.translationJa: 私は改訂された配送日程についてパテルさんと同意見です。
questions.explanationJa: 人と意見が一致する場合はagree with 人です。agree toは提案や条件を受け入れるときに使います。

questions.prompt: The new filters can be installed ------- ease by one technician.

choices.A: in
choices.B: with
choices.C: at
choices.D: of

questions.translationJa: 新しいフィルターは技術者1人で簡単に取り付けられます。
questions.explanationJa: with easeは「容易に」を表す定着表現で、easeの前にwithを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about accompaniment.

choices.A: Our auditor arrived by two assistants.
choices.B: Our auditor arrived two assistants with together.
choices.C: Our auditor arrived with two assistants.
choices.D: Our auditor arrived from two assistants accompanying.

questions.translationJa: 監査担当者は2人の助手とともに到着しました。
questions.explanationJa: 同行者はwith＋人で表します。到着という動作の行為者を示すbyではありません。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence describing a person’s attribute.

choices.A: We need an operator by strong data-analysis skills.
choices.B: We need an operator with has strong data-analysis skills.
choices.C: We need with strong data-analysis skills an operator has.
choices.D: We need an operator with strong data-analysis skills.

questions.translationJa: 私たちには高いデータ分析能力を備えたオペレーターが必要です。
questions.explanationJa: with strong ... skillsがoperatorを後ろから説明し、「その能力を備えた」を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about an instrument.

choices.A: The inspector checked the surface with a magnifying glass.
choices.B: The inspector checked the surface from a magnifying glass.
choices.C: The inspector was checked the surface by a magnifying glass.
choices.D: The inspector checked with the surface a magnifying glass.

questions.translationJa: 検査員は拡大鏡を使って表面を確認しました。
questions.explanationJa: 具体的な道具を使って行う行為にはwith a magnifying glassが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about ingredients.

choices.A: The café prepares its soup toward seasonal vegetables.
choices.B: The café prepares its soup with seasonal vegetables.
choices.C: The café prepares with its soup seasonal vegetables.
choices.D: The café prepares its soup by seasonal vegetables are used.

questions.translationJa: そのカフェは季節の野菜を使ってスープを作ります。
questions.explanationJa: 料理に使う材料をwithで示し、prepare A with Bの語順にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about cause.

choices.A: The applicant’s voice shook to nervousness.
choices.B: The applicant’s voice was shook by nervousness with.
choices.C: The applicant’s voice shook with nervousness.
choices.D: The applicant’s voice shook nervousness at.

questions.translationJa: 応募者の声は緊張で震えました。
questions.explanationJa: 感情・状態が反応の原因になるとき、shake with nervousnessのようにwithを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence with an adjective complement after with.

choices.A: The meeting ended with several questions were unanswered.
choices.B: The meeting ended several questions with unanswered.
choices.C: The meeting ended by several questions unanswered.
choices.D: The meeting ended with several questions unanswered.

questions.translationJa: 会議は複数の質問が未回答のまま終了しました。
questions.explanationJa: with＋名詞＋形容詞で、その名詞がどの状態にあるかを付帯状況として示します。wereは不要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence with an -ing phrase.

choices.A: We left the office with the air conditioner running.
choices.B: We left the office with the air conditioner was running.
choices.C: We left the office by the air conditioner running.
choices.D: We left with running the office the air conditioner.

questions.translationJa: 私たちはエアコンを動かしたままオフィスを出ました。
questions.explanationJa: air conditionerがrunする能動関係なのでwith＋名詞＋現在分詞を使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence with a past participle.

choices.A: With the final invoice approving, payment can be released.
choices.B: With the final invoice approved, payment can be released.
choices.C: By the final invoice approved, payment can be released.
choices.D: With approved the final invoice is, payment can be released.

questions.translationJa: 最終請求書が承認されたので、支払いを実行できます。
questions.explanationJa: invoiceはapproveされる側なので過去分詞approvedを用います。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about agreement with a person.

choices.A: I agree to our legal adviser on this point.
choices.B: I agree our legal adviser with on this point.
choices.C: I agree with our legal adviser on this point.
choices.D: I am agree with our legal adviser on this point.

questions.translationJa: この点について私は法務アドバイザーと同意見です。
questions.explanationJa: 人との意見一致はagree with 人です。agreeは動詞なのでam agreeとはしません。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about relevance.

choices.A: The billing error has nothing doing with the new vendor.
choices.B: The billing error has not to do the new vendor with.
choices.C: The billing error is nothing to do by the new vendor.
choices.D: The billing error has nothing to do with the new vendor.

questions.translationJa: その請求ミスは新しい取引先とは関係ありません。
questions.explanationJa: have nothing to do withは「〜と関係がない」を表す一まとまりの表現です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Aiko attended the briefing with her supervisor.”

choices.A: Aiko attended a briefing given only by her supervisor.
choices.B: Aiko and her supervisor attended the briefing together.
choices.C: Aiko replaced her supervisor at the briefing.
choices.D: Aiko attended after her supervisor had left.

questions.translationJa: アイコは上司と一緒に説明会へ出席しました。
questions.explanationJa: with her supervisorは上司が同行・同席したことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The candidate with international experience will lead the project.”

choices.A: The candidate who has international experience will lead the project.
choices.B: The candidate will gain experience only after leading the project.
choices.C: Every candidate from abroad will automatically lead the project.
choices.D: The project itself has international experience.

questions.translationJa: 国際業務の経験を持つ候補者がプロジェクトを率います。
questions.explanationJa: with international experienceは候補者がその経験を備えていることを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We opened the crate with a cordless drill.”

choices.A: A cordless drill opened the crate by itself.
choices.B: We found a cordless drill inside the crate.
choices.C: We opened the crate for the company that made the drill.
choices.D: We used a cordless drill to open the crate.

questions.translationJa: 私たちはコードレスドリルを使って木箱を開けました。
questions.explanationJa: with a cordless drillは開けるために使用した道具を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The snacks are made with rice flour.”

choices.A: The snacks are served beside a bag of rice flour.
choices.B: Rice flour is the machine that produces the snacks.
choices.C: Rice flour is one of the ingredients used in the snacks.
choices.D: The snacks are delivered by a company named Rice Flour.

questions.translationJa: その軽食には材料として米粉が使われています。
questions.explanationJa: made withは製品・料理に用いられた材料の一つを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “He was trembling with anger.”

choices.A: He was calmly discussing anger with someone.
choices.B: His anger caused him to tremble.
choices.C: He trembled while carrying an angry customer.
choices.D: His anger disappeared because he trembled.

questions.translationJa: 彼は怒りで震えていました。
questions.explanationJa: with angerは怒りが震えの原因であることを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The director entered with the audience already seated.”

choices.A: When the director entered, the audience was already in its seats.
choices.B: The director asked the audience to leave before entering.
choices.C: The seated audience entered behind the director.
choices.D: The director entered because no seats were available.

questions.translationJa: ディレクターが入場したとき、聴衆はすでに着席していました。
questions.explanationJa: with＋名詞＋過去分詞は主節と同時に成立している背景状態を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The logo goes well with the new packaging.”

choices.A: The logo must be removed from the packaging.
choices.B: The packaging was transported with the logo company.
choices.C: The logo is physically moving toward the packaging.
choices.D: The logo and the new packaging look harmonious together.

questions.translationJa: そのロゴは新しい包装とよく調和します。
questions.explanationJa: go well withは色・デザインなどの組み合わせが調和することを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I agree with Mr. Chen.”

choices.A: I accepted a contract offered to Mr. Chen.
choices.B: Mr. Chen agreed to work for me.
choices.C: Mr. Chen and I share the same opinion.
choices.D: I spoke with Mr. Chen but rejected his view.

questions.translationJa: 私はチェンさんと同じ意見です。
questions.explanationJa: agree with 人は、その人の考えと自分の考えが一致することです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “This issue has little to do with pricing.”

choices.A: Pricing is the only cause of this issue.
choices.B: This issue is only slightly related to pricing.
choices.C: This issue must be completed before prices are set.
choices.D: The pricing team has little work to do.

questions.translationJa: この問題は価格設定とはほとんど関係がありません。
questions.explanationJa: have little to do withは関係性が小さいことを表し、義務のhave toではありません。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The crew completed the setup with ease.”

choices.A: The crew completed the setup without difficulty.
choices.B: The crew postponed the setup to make it easier.
choices.C: The crew completed only the easiest part of the setup.
choices.D: The crew required extensive help to complete the setup.

questions.translationJa: 作業員は設営を難なく完了しました。
questions.explanationJa: with easeはeasilyまたはwithout difficultyと言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: “Who will visit the supplier tomorrow?” “I’ll go ------- two quality engineers.”

choices.A: by
choices.B: from
choices.C: until
choices.D: with

questions.translationJa: 「明日、誰が仕入先を訪問しますか」「私が品質技術者2人と一緒に行きます」
questions.explanationJa: 一緒に訪問する同行者をwithで主語の行動につなぎます。

questions.prompt: “Which applicant should we interview first?” “The one ------- five years of logistics experience.”

choices.A: by
choices.B: at
choices.C: with
choices.D: toward

questions.translationJa: 「どの応募者を最初に面接すべきですか」「物流業務の経験が5年ある人です」
questions.explanationJa: with＋経験で、その応募者が備えている属性を後ろから特定します。

questions.prompt: “How did you remove the old seal?” “------- a heat gun and a plastic scraper.”

choices.A: By of
choices.B: With
choices.C: From
choices.D: During

questions.translationJa: 「古いシールをどうやって剥がしましたか」「ヒートガンとプラスチック製スクレーパーを使いました」
questions.explanationJa: 使用した具体的な道具を答えるためWithを使います。

questions.prompt: “Does this bread contain dairy products?” “No. It is baked ------- oat milk instead.”

choices.A: with
choices.B: toward
choices.C: beside
choices.D: by from

questions.translationJa: 「このパンには乳製品が入っていますか」「いいえ。代わりにオーツミルクを使って焼いています」
questions.explanationJa: 製造に使う材料・食材をwithで示します。

questions.prompt: “Why did the intern’s face turn red?” “It turned red ------- embarrassment.”

choices.A: to
choices.B: at
choices.C: by of
choices.D: with

questions.translationJa: 「なぜ研修生の顔が赤くなったのですか」「恥ずかしさで赤くなりました」
questions.explanationJa: embarrassmentが顔の変化を引き起こした原因なのでwithを使います。

questions.prompt: The team cannot launch the system ------- several security checks still incomplete.

choices.A: by
choices.B: for
choices.C: with
choices.D: unless of

questions.translationJa: 複数のセキュリティ確認が未完了のままでは、チームはシステムを公開できません。
questions.explanationJa: with＋名詞＋形容詞incompleteで、公開を妨げる現在の付帯状況を示します。

questions.prompt: The lobby became noisy, ------- a maintenance crew testing every alarm.

choices.A: to
choices.B: with
choices.C: during
choices.D: by

questions.translationJa: 保守作業員がすべての警報器を試験していたため、ロビーは騒がしくなりました。
questions.explanationJa: crewがtestingする能動関係をwith＋名詞＋現在分詞で主節に添えます。

questions.prompt: ------- all customer records backed up, the database migration can begin.

choices.A: With
choices.B: By
choices.C: Until
choices.D: From

questions.translationJa: すべての顧客記録がバックアップ済みなので、データベース移行を開始できます。
questions.explanationJa: recordsはback upされる側なので、With＋名詞＋過去分詞が適切です。

questions.prompt: “Do you support the director’s view?” “Yes, I agree ------- her on this point.”

choices.A: to
choices.B: for
choices.C: at
choices.D: with

questions.translationJa: 「取締役の見解を支持しますか」「はい、この点では彼女と同意見です」
questions.explanationJa: 同意する相手が人なのでagree with herを使います。agree to herではありません。

questions.prompt: “Was the installation difficult?” “Not at all. The technicians completed it -------.”

choices.A: with easy
choices.B: in ease
choices.C: with ease
choices.D: by easily

questions.translationJa: 「取り付けは難しかったですか」「全く。技術者たちは難なく完了しました」
questions.explanationJa: 「容易に」は定着表現with easeで表します。形容詞easyを直接withの後には置きません。
